notes.title: Community Songs Update
notes.notes:
Big Update for Taiko Frenzy!

Community Songs are now fully integrated into the game! Easily browse, explore, and download songs created by players worldwide—jump right into the amazing creations the community has to offer!  

[previewyoutube=OEyhIwCGlBs;full][/previewyoutube]

🎵 *All custom songs are sourced from the Taiko Frenzy page on mod.io.*  
Want to share your own masterpieces? Head to our mod.io page: mod.io Game Page 

Check out the Guides section to learn how to create custom songs and share them with the world. With these tools, we’re excited to see the community’s creativity flourish!  

To celebrate this exciting update, Taiko Frenzy is part of the Autumn Sales, enjoy a fantastic 30% discount and dive into the game now!

✨ Don’t forget to join our Discord to share your thoughts, feedback, or just say hi: Discord Community Server  

Let’s keep drumming, and have fun! 🥁

notes.title: Patch 1.1.2
notes.notes:
Exciting news for the community: Taiko Frenzy now has an official page on mod.io! You can check it out here: mod.io Taiko Frenzy.

https://i.imgur.com/4pwprb9.png

This page is the go-to spot for sharing and downloading custom songs. You’ll also find helpful guides on creating your own custom tracks using the TF Editor!

We’ve also updated both the game and TF Editor to simplify the custom song installation process. Now, you can easily drag and drop zip files into the correct folder to install your favorite tracks. Learn more here: Install and play custom songs.

If you’d like to share your creations with the community, it's easy to do! Follow this guide: Upload your custom song.

We hope you enjoy these improvements! This is just the beginning—we’re working on adding an in-game song browser UI in future updates, so stay tuned!

notes.title: Patch 1.1.1
notes.notes:
Bug fixes

 Pause Menu: Resolved an issue where the game could not be unpaused in specific situations after the application was put in background.

notes.title: Patch 1.1.0
notes.notes:
Taiko Frenzy is taking part of the Steam Rhythm Fest this year so now is the perfect time to get your hands on the game with a nice 20% discount.

It's the occasion for us to release our new update with a couple of fixes and new features for the game and the song editor!

Game updates

 Spanish language support: all the game has been translated into Spanish
 Custom song new features support: start offset and floating BPM
 Bug fix and optimizations for Services connection 
 Bug fix for currency not being gained in certain conditions
 Bug fix for UI animations not playing at the correct framerate
 Bug fix for inventory equipment not correctly applied between launches


TF Editor updates

 Beatsaber map parsing optimizations
 osu! taiko map parsing optimizations
 Floating BPM support, you can now set BPM with decimals. It also works for BPM Events.
 Start offset support
 Track scan: when you open a project, your track will be scanned to detect potential issues (like overlapping notes) and fix it
 BPM Event time signature: you can now set the amount of beats per bar for each BPM Event
 Bug fix for BPM Events that broke the grid generation / notes timings
